Quick triage

SymptomLikely causeFix
token is missing required scopesgh OAuth token lacks projectgh auth refresh -s project
Could not resolve to a ProjectV2Wrong owner/number or token scopeRe-check gh project list; refresh scope
Could not resolve to a node with the global idStale/placeholder item IDRe-read gh project item-list; use fresh ID
Required check stuck/pendingPath-filtered required workflowRemove path filter; keep required job always-on
Audit: Resource not accessibleMissing project token/scopeFix TRACKER_TOKEN scope; never widen blindly
WIP violationTwo In Progress tasks for one ownerFinish/block/defer one; document exception
Parent Done with open childrenClosed before children finishedReopen or record explicit deferral with plan-change
Config validation failsBad JSON/field/option mismatchRun validator; fix against config schema
Release published unexpectedlyMissing tag/dispatch/environment guardStop and rotate tokens; add guards; dry-run default
Stale docs linkRenamed heading/fileUpdate relative link or add redirect-safe anchor

Quick diagnostics

gh --version && gh auth status
gh project list --owner @me --format json
gh project field-list PROJECT_NUMBER --owner @me --format json
node scripts/github/validate-config.mjs tracker.config.json
node scripts/github/audit.mjs --config tracker.config.json --advisory

Audit checklist (10 invariants)

  • ☐ Open release work has milestone + native type.
  • ☐ Project fields complete (Release/Sprint for release work; Area/Kind/Estimate; Source for downstream).
  • ☐ No Done parent with open children unless deferral is recorded.
  • ☐ No In Progress without assignee + check-in.
  • ☐ WIP ≤ 1 per owner (or documented exception).
  • ☐ Blocked has reason + dependency link.
  • ☐ No duplicate/retired labels.
  • ☐ Sprint/release Done has exit evidence.
  • ☐ Template version pinned; downstream context complete.
  • ☐ No secrets in issues/comments/artifacts.

Advisory in CI first; required at release gates once stable. Audit token is project-scoped and never logged.

Escalate

Capture exact command, exit code, and sanitized stderr; check TROUBLESHOOTING first. If the tracker itself is deficient, report downstream with pinned version and environment — never include tokens or vulnerability details.
